description: One sheet, with its formats, charts and validation, copied into another spreadsheet (or the same one when destination is empty). It arrives last, titled "Copy of <title>"; returns its sheetId and title.

account.description: Which account this writes as: a label from list_accounts (its editors section). Required; writes have no default.

destination_spreadsheet_id.description: The spreadsheet to copy into, by id or URL. Empty means the same one.

sheet.description: The sheet's title or sheetId. Empty means the first sheet.

spreadsheet_id.description: The spreadsheet's id, or its URL.

name: copy_sheet_to
title: Copy a sheet to another spreadsheet
